text: Great! I found relevant information. Let me look at the most relevant file: `docs/admin/billing-usage/usage-limits.md` which seems to have the information about API rate limits.

Perfect! I found the exact information. The documentation clearly states that API rate limits are shown in **Admin Panel > API > Limits** at `https://admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits`. The section "API rate limits" explicitly mentions that "They are shown in [Admin Panel > API > Limits](https://admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits)." and the table under "Open usage and limits" also lists "Review API rate limits | [Admin Panel > API > Limits](https://admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits)".

Additionally, the "Completion rate limits" section mentions that "Completion rate limits are listed per model", which directly answers the "per-model" part of the question.

So the answer is: **Admin Panel > API > Limits** at `https://admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits`

Let me format this properly with the citation.

content.text:
You can see per-model rate limits at **Admin Panel > API > Limits** (`https://admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits`).

[API rate limits](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/usage-limits#api-rate-limits)
[Open usage and limits](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/usage-limits#open-usage-and-limits)
